 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'张三'</span>
 &nbsp;  }
})
<span class="hljs-comment">// 生成 URL: /user?id=123&amp;name=张三</span>
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 组件内获取</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$route</span>.<span class="hljs-property">query</span>.<span class="hljs-property">id</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 123</span>
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-95">5. Props 解耦（参数注入组件）</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方式一：静态值</span>
{
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/static'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">component</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">StaticPage</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">props</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">title</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'静态标题'</span>
 &nbsp;  } <span class="hljs-comment">// 组件通过 props: ['title'] 接收</span>
}
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 方式二：params 参数自动解耦（布尔模式）</span>
{
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/user/:id'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">component</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">User</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">props</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 组件通过 props: ['id'] 接收</span>
}
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 方式三：自定义函数（支持 query）</span>
{
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/search'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">component</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Search</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">props</span>: <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">route</span> =&gt;</span> ({
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">keyword</span>: route.<span class="hljs-property">query</span>.<span class="hljs-property">keyword</span>
 &nbsp;  }) <span class="hljs-comment">// 动态映射</span>
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-96">四、路由跳转方法</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-97">1. 声明式导航（模板中）</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-代码段" lang="代码段">&lt;router-link to="/home"&gt;Home&lt;/router-link&gt;
​
&lt;router-link :to="{ name: 'User', params: { id: 123 } }"&gt;User&lt;/router-link&gt;
​
&lt;router-link :to="{ path: '/search', query: { q: 'vue' } }"&gt;Search&lt;/router-link&gt;
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-98">2. 编程式导航（JS 中）</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 基本跳转</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$router</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/home'</span>)
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$router</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'User'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">params</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">123</span>
 &nbsp;  }
})
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 替换当前历史记录</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$router</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/about'</span>)
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 后退/前进</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$router</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">go</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 后退一步</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-99">五、导航守卫（路由拦截）</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-100">1. 全局前置守卫</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Vue2</span>
router.<span class="hljs-title function_">beforeEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>, next</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (to.<span class="hljs-property">meta</span>.<span class="hljs-property">requiresAuth</span> &amp;&amp; !<span class="hljs-title function_">isAuthenticated</span>()) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/login'</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 未登录时跳转到登录页</span>
 &nbsp;  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 继续路由跳转</span>
 &nbsp;  }
})
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// Vue3（无需调用 next，直接 return）</span>
router.<span class="hljs-title function_">beforeEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (to.<span class="hljs-property">meta</span>.<span class="hljs-property">requiresAuth</span> &amp;&amp; !<span class="hljs-title function_">isAuthenticated</span>()) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">'/login'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 直接返回路径或 false 阻止跳转</span>
 &nbsp;  }
})
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-101">2. 路由独享守卫</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript">{
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/admin'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">component</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Admin</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">beforeEnter</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>, next</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 仅针对 /admin 路由的权限验证</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title function_">isAdmin</span>()) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/forbidden'</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-102">3. 组件内守卫（Vue2 特有）</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">beforeRouteEnter</span>(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>, next</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 在渲染该组件的路由确认前调用</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 无法访问 this（组件实例还未创建）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">vm</span> =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 通过 vm 访问组件实例</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  })
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">beforeRouteUpdate</span>(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>, next</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 路由更新时调用（如 params 变化但组件复用）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span>(to.<span class="hljs-property">params</span>.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>()
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">beforeRouteLeave</span>(<span class="hljs-params">to, <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>, next</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 导航离开该组件的路由时调用</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">hasUnsavedChanges</span>()) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 阻止离开</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">next</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-103">六、Vue3 路由新增特性</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-104">1. 组合式 API 支持</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  useRouter,
 &nbsp;  useRoute
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue-router'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">setup</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> router = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRouter</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> route = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRoute</span>()
​
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">goToUser</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  router.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'User'</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">params</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">123</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  })
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
​
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">currentPath</span>: route.<span class="hljs-property">path</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  goToUser
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-105">2. 路由懒加载（与 Vue2 一致，但推荐写法）</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 推荐使用</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Home</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./views/Home.vue'</span>)
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 带加载状态</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Home</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>( <span class="hljs-comment">/* webpackChunkName: "home" */</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./views/Home.vue'</span>)
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-106">3. 路由别名与重定向</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript">{
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">redirect</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/home'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 重定向</span>
}, {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/home'</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">component</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Home</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">alias</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 别名，访问 / 等价于 /home</span>
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-107">七、面试高频考点</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>params</code> 和 <code>query</code> 的区别</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>params</code></strong>：必须在路由配置中定义占位符（如 <code>/user/:id</code>），只能通过 <code>name</code> 跳转</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>query</code></strong>：无需定义占位符，生成类似 <code>?key=value</code> 的 URL 参数，支持 <code>path</code> 跳转</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Vue2 与 Vue3 路由的主要差异</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装方式（<code>Vue.use</code> 到 <code>createRouter</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>组合式 API 支持</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>导航守卫的调用方式简化</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>导航守卫的执行顺序</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>全局前置守卫 → 路由独享守卫 → 组件内守卫 → 全局解析守卫 → 全局后置钩子</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>路由懒加载的原理</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>通过动态 <code>import</code> 实现组件的按需加载，减少首屏加载时间</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>路由钩子中 <code>next()</code> 的注意事项</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Vue2</strong> 中必须调用 <code>next()</code>，否则路由跳转被阻止</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Vue3</strong> 中可直接 <code>return</code> 路径或 <code>false</code>，无需调用 <code>next()</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-108">10：Vue2和Vue3的状态管理</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-109">一、Vue2 状态管理：Vuex</h4>
<p><strong>Vuex</strong> 是 <strong>Vue2</strong> 官方推荐的状态管理库，基于 <strong>单向数据流</strong> 设计，用于集中管理组件共享状态。核心思想是将共享状态抽离为一个全局的「Store」，供所有组件访问。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-110">1. 核心概念</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>State</strong>：存储全局状态的对象（唯一数据源）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Getter</strong>：类似组件的计算属性，用于派生 State 中的数据（缓存特性）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Mutation</strong>：唯一修改 State 的方式（同步操作），必须是纯函数。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Action</strong>：处理异步操作（如接口请求），通过提交 Mutation 修改 State。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Module</strong>：拆分 Store 为多个模块（解决状态过多导致的臃肿）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-111">2. 基本使用（Vue2 + Vuex）</h5>
<p><strong>(1）安装与配置</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 安装：npm install vuex@3 （Vue2 对应 Vuex 3.x）</span>
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// store/index.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Vue</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Vuex</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vuex'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-title class_">Vue</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">use</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Vuex</span>)
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> store = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Vuex</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Store</span>({
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 状态</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">count</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">user</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'张三'</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 派生状态（计算属性）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">getters</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算用户信息字符串</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">userInfo</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`姓名：<span class="hljs-subst">${state.user.name}</span>，年龄：<span class="hljs-subst">${state.user.age}</span>`</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 带参数的 getter（返回函数）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">getUserAge</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">minAge</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> state.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> &gt;= minAge
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 同步修改状态（必须是同步函数）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">mutations</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 第一个参数固定为 state</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  state.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>++
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 接收额外参数（payload）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">setUserAge</span>(<span class="hljs-params">state, payload</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  state.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = payload
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 处理异步操作（可提交 mutations）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">actions</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 第一个参数为 context（包含 commit、state 等）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>(<span class="hljs-params">context</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 模拟接口请求</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> axios.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/user'</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 通过 commit 调用 mutation 修改状态</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  context.<span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'setUserAge'</span>, res.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 简化写法（解构 context）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateCount</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  commit
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }, num</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'increment'</span>, num)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 5. 模块拆分（复杂项目用）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">modules</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 购物车模块</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">cart</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 开启命名空间（避免 mutation/action 重名）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">namespaced</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">items</span>: []
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">mutations</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">addItem</span>(<span class="hljs-params">state, item</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  state.<span class="hljs-property">items</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(item)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
})
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> store
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(2）在组件中使用</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 main.js 中挂载 store</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> store <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./store'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Vue</span>({
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">el</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#app'</span>,
 &nbsp;  store, <span class="hljs-comment">// 挂载后组件可通过 this.$store 访问</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">render</span>: <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">h</span> =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">App</span>)
})
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 组件中使用</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">mounted</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 访问 state</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$store</span>.<span class="hljs-property">state</span>.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 访问 getter</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$store</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getters</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userInfo</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用 mutation（同步）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$store</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'increment'</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用 action（异步）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$store</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispatch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'fetchUserInfo'</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用模块中的 mutation（需加命名空间）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">$store</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'cart/addItem'</span>, {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'商品'</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  })
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(3）辅助函数（简化代码）</strong></p>
<p><strong>Vuex</strong> 提供 mapState、mapGetters、mapMutations、mapActions 辅助函数，直接将 Store 中的内容映射到组件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  mapState,
 &nbsp;  mapGetters,
 &nbsp;  mapMutations,
 &nbsp;  mapActions
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vuex'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">computed</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 映射 state 到计算属性</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ...<span class="hljs-title function_">mapState</span>([<span class="hljs-string">'count'</span>]),
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 映射 getter 到计算属性</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ...<span class="hljs-title function_">mapGetters</span>([<span class="hljs-string">'userInfo'</span>])
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">methods</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 映射 mutation 到方法（直接调用 this.increment()）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ...<span class="hljs-title function_">mapMutations</span>([<span class="hljs-string">'increment'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'setUserAge'</span>]),
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 映射 action 到方法（直接调用 this.fetchUserInfo()）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ...<span class="hljs-title function_">mapActions</span>([<span class="hljs-string">'fetchUserInfo'</span>])
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-112">二、Vue3 状态管理：Pinia</h4>
<p><strong>Pinia</strong> 是 <strong>Vue3</strong> 官方推荐的状态管理库，是 Vuex 的继任者，简化了 API 并原生支持 TypeScript，更符合 Vue3 的 Composition API。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-113">1. 核心改进（对比 Vuex）</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>移除 <code>Mutation</code></strong>，直接在 <code>Action</code> 中修改状态（同步 / 异步均可）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>无嵌套模块</strong>，通过「Store 拆分」替代（每个 Store 独立）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>原生支持 TypeScript</strong>，无需额外类型声明。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>简化语法</strong>，更贴合 Composition API。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-114">2. 基本使用（Vue3 + Pinia）</h5>
<p><strong>(1）安装与配置</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 安装：npm install pinia</span>
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// store/index.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  createPinia
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'pinia'</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 创建 pinia 实例</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pinia = <span class="hljs-title function_">createPinia</span>()
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> pinia
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 在 main.js 中挂载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  createApp
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">App</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./App.vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> pinia <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./store'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-title function_">createApp</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">App</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">use</span>(pinia).<span class="hljs-title function_">mount</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'#app'</span>)
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(2）定义 Store（核心）</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// store/user.js（用户相关状态）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  defineStore
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'pinia'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 第一个参数：store 唯一标识（必须唯一）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 第二个参数：配置对象（state、getters、actions）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useUserStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'user'</span>, {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 状态（返回初始值的函数）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> ({
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">count</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">user</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'张三'</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }),
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 派生状态（类似计算属性）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">getters</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 接收 state 作为参数</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">userInfo</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-string">`姓名：<span class="hljs-subst">${state.user.name}</span>，年龄：<span class="hljs-subst">${state.user.age}</span>`</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 访问其他 getter（用 this）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">doubleCount</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> state.<span class="hljs-property">count</span> * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 带参数的 getter（返回函数）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">getUserAge</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">minAge</span>) =&gt;</span> state.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> &gt;= minAge
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 方法（同步/异步均可，直接修改 state）</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">actions</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 同步修改</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>++ <span class="hljs-comment">// 直接通过 this 访问 state</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 接收参数</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">setUserAge</span>(<span class="hljs-params">age</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = age
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 异步操作（直接修改状态，无需 commit）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> axios.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/user'</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = res.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用其他 action</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateAndFetch</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用同步 action</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用异步 action</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
})
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(3）在组件中使用（Options API）</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 引入 store</span>
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  useUserStore
 &nbsp;  } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/store/user'</span>
​
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">data</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {

 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },

 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 访问 state</span>

 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userStore</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userInfo</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用 action</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userStore</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userStore</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>()
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(4）在组件中使用（Composition API）</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  useUserStore
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/store/user'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  onMounted
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">setup</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">useUserStore</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(userStore.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 访问状态</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  userStore.<span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用方法</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  })
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  userStore
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>(5）状态更新的高级用法</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>批量修改状态</strong>：使用 <code>$patch</code>（更高效，适合多属性修改）</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方式1：对象形式</span>
userStore.$patch({
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">count</span>: <span class="hljs-number">10</span>,
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">'user.age'</span>: <span class="hljs-number">25</span>
})
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 方式2：函数形式（复杂逻辑）</span>
userStore.$patch(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp;  state.<span class="hljs-property">count</span> += <span class="hljs-number">5</span>
 &nbsp;  state.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = <span class="hljs-number">30</span>
})
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>重置状态</strong>：使用 <code>$reset</code>（恢复到初始值）</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript">userStore.$reset() <span class="hljs-comment">// 重置所有状态</span>
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>解构状态</strong>：使用 <code>toRefs</code> 保持响应式</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  toRefs
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">useUserStore</span>()
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
 &nbsp;  count,
 &nbsp;  user
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">toRefs</span>(userStore) <span class="hljs-comment">// 解构后仍为响应式</span>
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-115">3. Store 拆分与组合</h5>
<p><strong>Pinia</strong> 无需嵌套模块，通过多个独立 Store 实现拆分，需要时在组件中组合使用：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 引入多个 store</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  useUserStore
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/store/user'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  useCartStore
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/store/cart'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">setup</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">useUserStore</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cartStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCartStore</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  userStore,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  cartStore
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-116">三、Vuex 与 Pinia 核心区别对比</h4>








































<table><thead><tr><th>特性</th><th>Vuex（Vue2）</th><th>Pinia（Vue3）</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>状态修改</strong></td><td>必须通过 Mutation（同步）</td><td>直接在 Action 中修改（同步 / 异步）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>异步操作</strong></td><td>必须在 Action 中，通过 commit</td><td>直接在 Action 中修改状态</td></tr><tr><td><strong>模块管理</strong></td><td>嵌套模块（namespaced）</td><td>多个独立 Store 拆分</td></tr><tr><td><strong>TypeScript 支持</strong></td><td>需手动声明类型</td><td>原生支持</td></tr><tr><td><strong>语法简洁度</strong></td><td>较繁琐（需 commit、dispatch）</td><td>简洁（直接操作）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>生态兼容性</strong></td><td>仅 Vue2</td><td>仅 Vue3（推荐）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-117">四、面试高频考点</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Vuex 为什么要求 Mutation 必须是同步函数？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>答</strong>：因为 Vuex 的 devtools 工具需要追踪状态变化，异步操作会导致 devtools 无法准确记录 mutation 调用顺序，难以调试。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Pinia 相比 Vuex 有哪些优势？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>答</strong>：移除 Mutation 简化逻辑、原生支持 TypeScript、更贴合 Vue3 Composition API、无需嵌套模块等。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>如何在 Vue 组件中高效使用 Vuex/Pinia 状态？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>答</strong>：Vuex 用辅助函数（<code>mapState</code> 等）；Pinia 直接通过 store 实例访问，结合 <code>toRefs</code> 保持响应式。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>状态管理的适用场景？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>答</strong>：多组件共享数据（如用户信息、购物车）、跨层级组件通信、需要持久化的状态（如登录令牌）。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-118">11：VUE2和VUE3的Computed 和 watch</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-119">一、Computed 和 Watch 的核心区别</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-120">1. 核心差异对比表</h5>













































<table><thead><tr><th>特性</th><th>Computed</th><th>Watch</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>缓存机制</strong></td><td>有缓存，依赖项不变时直接返回缓存值</td><td>无缓存，数据变化时立即执行回调</td></tr><tr><td><strong>触发时机</strong></td><td>依赖项变化后，下次访问时更新</td><td>数据变化时立即执行回调</td></tr><tr><td><strong>适用场景</strong></td><td>依赖多个数据计算一个新值</td><td>监听特定数据变化并执行副作用（如异步操作）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>异步支持</strong></td><td>不支持（异步操作会导致缓存失效）</td><td>支持（可在回调中执行异步操作）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>初始执行</strong></td><td>默认不执行，访问时计算</td><td>可通过 <code>immediate: true</code> 强制初始执行</td></tr><tr><td><strong>深度监听</strong></td><td>不支持（需手动处理嵌套对象）</td><td>支持（通过 <code>deep: true</code> 监听对象所有属性）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>回调参数</strong></td><td>无（通过返回值获取结果）</td><td>接收 <code>newVal</code> 和 <code>oldVal</code>（深度监听时 <code>oldVal</code> 可能与 <code>newVal</code> 相同）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h5 data-id="heading-121">2. 代码示例对比</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Computed 示例</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">data</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">firstName</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'张'</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">lastName</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'三'</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">computed</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 基础用法（缓存特性）</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">fullName</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">firstName</span> + <span class="hljs-string">' '</span> + <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lastName</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// Watch 示例</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">data</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">userId</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">userInfo</span>: {}
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">watch</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听简单数据变化</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">userId</span>(<span class="hljs-params">newVal, oldVal</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>(newVal)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 深度监听对象</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">userInfo</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">handler</span>(<span class="hljs-params">newVal</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理对象变化</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">deep</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 深度监听</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">immediate</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始执行一次</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  },
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">methods</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUserInfo</span>(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> axios.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`/api/user/<span class="hljs-subst">${id}</span>`</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userInfo</span> = res.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-122">二、响应式原理（Vue2 vs Vue3）</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-123">1. Vue2 响应式原理</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Computed</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>创建 <code>Computed Watcher</code>，并将 <code>dirty</code> 标记设为 <code>true</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问计算属性时触发 <code>getter</code>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>若 <code>dirty</code> 为 <code>true</code>，重新计算值并缓存</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>将 <code>dirty</code> 设为 <code>false</code>，依赖收集（将计算属性的 Watcher 添加到依赖项的 Dep 中）</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>依赖项变化时，触发计算属性的 Watcher 更新，将 <code>dirty</code> 设为 <code>true</code></p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Watch</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>创建 <code>User Watcher</code>，若 <code>immediate: true</code> 则立即执行回调</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>触发被监听属性的 <code>getter</code>，完成依赖收集（将 Watcher 添加到 Dep 中）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>被监听属性变化时，Dep 通知 Watcher 执行回调</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>若 <code>sync: true</code>，同步执行回调</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>否则将回调放入队列，通过 <code>nextTick</code> 异步执行</p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-124">2. Vue3 响应式原理</h5>
<p>Vue3 基于 Proxy 重构响应式系统，核心机制类似但更高效：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Computed</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>创建 <code>ComputedRefImpl</code> 对象，包含 <code>getter</code> 和 <code>setter</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问计算属性时触发 <code>getter</code>：</p>
<ul>
<li>通过 <code>track</code> 收集依赖（将计算属性与依赖项建立关联）</li>
<li>缓存计算结果，返回值</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>依赖项变化时，通过 <code>trigger</code> 触发更新，标记计算属性为「脏」</p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Watch</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>创建 <code>WatchEffect</code> 或 <code>WatchOptions</code> 实例</li>
<li>执行 <code>source</code> 函数获取初始值，收集依赖</li>
<li>依赖项变化时，执行回调函数</li>
<li>支持 <code>flush</code> 选项控制回调执行时机（<code>pre</code>/<code>post</code>/<code>sync</code>）</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-125">三、高频面试考点</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-126">1. <code>Computed</code> 缓存的意义</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p>避免重复计算，提升性能（尤其复杂计算场景）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>对比 <code>methods</code></strong>：每次调用都会重新执行函数，而 computed 仅依赖项变化时才重新计算</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-127">2. <code>Watch</code> 如何监听对象属性变化？</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>深度监听（<code>deep: true</code>）</strong> ：递归遍历对象所有属性，为每个属性创建依赖</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-attr">watch</span>: {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">obj</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-title function_">handler</span>(<span class="hljs-params">newVal</span>) { <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span> },
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">deep</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
 &nbsp;  }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>监听特定属性</strong>：通过路径监听</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-attr">watch</span>: {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">'obj.prop'</span>: { <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span> }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-128">3. Vue3 中如何使用？</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Computed</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  computed
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> count = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> doubleCount = <span class="hljs-title function_">computed</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> count.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Watch</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-JavaScript" lang="JavaScript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
 &nbsp;  watch,
 &nbsp;  ref
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> count = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
​
<span class="hljs-title function_">watch</span>(count, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">newVal, oldVal</span>) =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`count changed: <span class="hljs-subst">${oldVal}</span> -&gt; <span class="hljs-subst">${newVal}</span>`</span>)
})
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-129">4. 执行时机差异</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Computed</strong>：同步更新，依赖项变化后，下次访问时生效</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Watch</strong>：默认异步执行（通过 <code>nextTick</code>），可通过 <code>sync: true</code> 强制同步</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-130">5. 循环依赖问题</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Computed 依赖自身</strong>：Vue2 会导致无限循环（Vue3 会警告）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Watch 修改被监听值</strong>：可能导致无限循环，需谨慎处理</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-131">四、最佳实践建议</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>优先使用 Computed</strong>：当结果依赖于其他响应式数据时</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>使用 Watch 处理副作用</strong>：如异步操作、跨组件通信</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>避免在 Computed 中使用异步</strong>：会破坏缓存机制，改用 Watch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>深度监听慎用</strong>：对象层级过深时会影响性能，优先监听具体属性</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Vue3 推荐 Composition API</strong>：更灵活的依赖控制和类型支持</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-132">12：VUE2和VUE3的内置指令</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-133">一、Vue 常用内置指令（按使用频率排序）</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-134">1. <code>v-text</code> 与 <code>v-html</code>：文本渲染</h5>




















<table><thead><tr><th>指令</th><th>作用</th><th>注意事项</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>v-text</strong></td><td>渲染文本（等价于 <code>{{}}</code>）</td><td>会覆盖元素原内容，无 XSS 风险</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-html</strong></td><td>渲染 HTML 片段</td><td>有 XSS 风险（避免用于用户输入内容），Vue 模板语法（如 <code>{{}}</code>）不会被解析</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">    <span class="hljs-string">``</span><span class="hljs-string">``</span>代码段
    &lt;div v-text=<span class="hljs-string">"message"</span>&gt;&lt;<span class="hljs-regexp">/div&gt; &lt;div v-html="rawHtml"&gt;&lt;/</span>div&gt; <span class="hljs-string">``</span><span class="hljs-string">`
    ​
    ##### 2. `</span>v-show<span class="hljs-string">` 与 `</span>v-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>/v-<span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>/v-<span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span><span class="hljs-string">`：条件渲染
    | 指令组合 | 作用 | 核心差异 |
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |
    | **v-show** | 基于条件显示元素 | 通过 `</span><span class="hljs-attr">display</span>: none<span class="hljs-string">` 隐藏，初始渲染开销高，切换开销低 |
    | **v-if/v-else** | 基于条件渲染元素 | 条件为 false 时完全移除元素，初始渲染开销低，切换开销高 |
    **注意**：
    - `</span>v-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span><span class="hljs-string">` 可与 `</span>v-<span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span><span class="hljs-string">`/`</span>v-<span class="hljs-keyword">else</span><span class="hljs-string">` 组合，需紧邻使用（否则报错）
    - `</span>v-show<span class="hljs-string">` 不支持 `</span>&lt;template&gt;<span class="hljs-string">` 标签，`</span>v-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span><span class="hljs-string">` 支持
    **示例**：
    `</span><span class="hljs-string">``</span>vue
    &lt;div v-show=<span class="hljs-string">"isVisible"</span>&gt;始终存在于 <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DOM</span> 中&lt;/div&gt;
    ​
    &lt;div v-<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"type === 'A'"</span>&gt;A&lt;/div&gt;
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-else-if</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"type === 'B'"</span>&gt;</span>B<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-else</span>&gt;</span>Other<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
    <span class="hljs-string">``</span><span class="hljs-string">``</span>
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-135">3. <code>v-for</code>：列表渲染</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：基于可迭代数据（数组、对象、字符串等）重复渲染元素</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>语法</strong>：<code>v-for="(item, index) in items"</code>（数组）或 <code>v-for="(value, key) in object"</code>（对象）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>关键要求：必须绑定 key（提升 diff 算法效率，避免复用问题）</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-代码段" lang="代码段">&lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li v-for="(item, index) in list" :key="item.id"&gt;
        {{ index }}: {{ item.name }}
    &lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;
​
&lt;div v-for="(value, key) in user" :key="key"&gt;
    {{ key }}: {{ value }}
&lt;/div&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Vue3 中 <code>v-for</code> 与 <code>v-if</code> 优先级调整：<code>v-if</code> 现在可以访问 <code>v-for</code> 的变量</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>避免用 <code>index</code> 作为 <code>key</code>（数组排序 / 过滤时会导致问题）</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-136">4. <code>v-on</code>（缩写 <code>@</code>）：事件绑定</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：绑定 DOM 事件或组件自定义事件</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>修饰符（核心常用）</strong> ：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.stop</code></strong>：阻止事件冒泡（<code>event.stopPropagation()</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.prevent</code></strong>：阻止默认行为（<code>event.preventDefault()</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.once</code></strong>：事件仅触发一次</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.native</code></strong>：监听组件根元素的原生事件（Vue2 常用，Vue3 移除）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>.enter/.esc 等：按键修饰符（监听特定按键）</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-代码段" lang="代码段">&lt;button @click="handleClick"&gt;点击&lt;/button&gt;
​
&lt;form @submit.prevent="handleSubmit"&gt;
    &lt;input @keyup.enter="handleEnter"&gt;
&lt;/form&gt;
​
&lt;button @click="handleClickWithEvent($event, arg)"&gt;传参&lt;/button&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-137">5. <code>v-bind</code>（缩写 <code>:</code>）：属性绑定</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：动态绑定 HTML 属性、组件 props 或 CSS 类</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>修饰符</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.camel</code></strong>：将短横线命名转换为驼峰（如 <code>:svg-icon.camel="iconName"</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.prop</code></strong>：强制绑定为 DOM property（如 <code>:value.prop="value"</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>.attr：强制绑定为 DOM attribute（默认行为，可省略）</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-代码段" lang="代码段">&lt;img :src="imageUrl" :alt="imageAlt"&gt;
​
&lt;div :class="{ active: isActive }" :style="{ color: textColor }"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
​
&lt;ChildComponent :user="currentUser"&gt;&lt;/ChildComponent&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-138">6. <code>v-model</code>：双向绑定</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：在表单元素或组件上创建双向数据绑定</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>支持元素</strong>：<code>input</code>（文本 / 复选框 / 单选）、<code>select</code>、<code>textarea</code>、自定义组件</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>修饰符</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.lazy</code></strong>：监听 <code>change</code> 事件（而非 <code>input</code>），适用于失焦后同步</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>.number</code></strong>：将输入值转为数字（如表单输入的字符串转为 Number）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>.trim：自动移除输入值两端空格</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-代码段" lang="代码段">&lt;input v-model="message" placeholder="输入文本"&gt;
​
&lt;input type="checkbox" v-model="isAgreed"&gt;
​
&lt;input v-model.lazy="username"&gt; &lt;input v-model.number="age"&gt; &lt;input v-model.trim="searchQuery"&gt; ```
​
##### 7. `v-slot`（缩写 `#`）：插槽绑定
- **作用**：声明具名插槽或作用域插槽（详见「插槽」章节）
- **语法**：`v-slot:name` 或 `#name`，仅用于 `&lt;template&gt;` 或组件标签
- **注意**：Vue3 中统一用 `v-slot` 替代 Vue2 的 `slot` 属性
**示例**：
```vue
&lt;ChildComponent&gt;
    &lt;template #header&gt;头部内容&lt;/template&gt;
    &lt;template #default&gt;默认内容&lt;/template&gt;
&lt;/ChildComponent&gt;
​
&lt;ChildComponent&gt;
    &lt;template #item="slotProps"&gt;
        {{ slotProps.item.name }}
    &lt;/template&gt;
&lt;/ChildComponent&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-139">8. 性能与编译相关指令</h5>



































<table><thead><tr><th>指令</th><th>作用</th><th>使用场景</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>v-once</strong></td><td>仅渲染一次，后续更新跳过</td><td>静态内容（如版权信息），优化性能</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-pre</strong></td><td>跳过编译，直接渲染原始内容</td><td>显示 Vue 模板语法（如 <code>{{}}</code> 本身），或加速大量静态内容渲染</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-memo</strong></td><td>缓存子树，依赖数组不变则不更新</td><td>海量列表渲染（如 1000+ 项的 <code>v-for</code>），减少重复计算</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-cloak</strong></td><td>隐藏未编译的模板</td><td>无构建工具的环境，避免页面加载时闪现 <code>{{}}</code> 标</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-xml" lang="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-once</span>&gt;</span>{{ staticMessage }}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-pre</span>&gt;</span>{{ 这里的 {{}} 会被原样显示 }}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
​
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-for</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"item in bigList"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">:key</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"item.id"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-memo</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"[item.id, item.status]"</span>&gt;</span>
 &nbsp;  {{ item.name }} - {{ item.status }}
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
​
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">style</span>&gt;</span><span class="css"> <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[v-cloak]</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: none; } </span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">style</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-cloak</span>&gt;</span>{{ message }}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span> 
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-140">二、Vue2 与 Vue3 指令差异</h4>






























<table><thead><tr><th>指令</th><th>Vue2 特性</th><th>Vue3 特性</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>v-model</strong></td><td>组件中需用 <code>value</code> prop + <code>input</code> 事件</td><td>统一为 <code>modelValue</code> prop + <code>update:modelValue</code> 事件</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-slot</strong></td><td>需与 <code>slot</code> 属性配合</td><td>完全替代 <code>slot</code>，支持动态插槽名</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-memo</strong></td><td>无</td><td>新增，优化性能</td></tr><tr><td><strong>v-on</strong></td><td>支持 <code>.native</code> 修饰符</td><td>移除 <code>.native</code>，组件事件需显式声明</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-141">三、面试高频考点</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-if</code> 与 <code>v-show</code> 的选择依据</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>频繁切换用 <code>v-show</code></strong>（切换开销低）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>条件不常变化或初始条件为 false 用 <code>v-if</code></strong>（初始渲染开销低）</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-for</code> 中 <code>key</code> 的作用</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>帮助 Vue 的 diff 算法识别节点唯一性，避免不必要的 DOM 操作</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不推荐用 <code>index</code> 作为 <code>key</code></strong>（数组排序 / 过滤时会导致节点复用错误）</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-model</code> 的实现原理</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>本质是语法糖：<code>v-bind</code> 绑定 <code>value</code> + <code>v-on</code> 监听 <code>input</code> 事件</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>示例</strong>：<code>&lt;input v-model="val"&gt;</code> 等价于 <code>&lt;input :value="val" @input="val = $event.target.value"&gt;</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-pre</code> 与 <code>v-cloak</code> 的区别</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-pre</code></strong>：跳过编译，直接显示原始内容（主动不编译）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-cloak</code></strong>：编译完成前隐藏内容（等待编译完成后显示）</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>v-memo</code> 的适用场景</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>仅推荐用于 1000+ 项的长列表，普通场景使用会增加内存开销</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-142">最后</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>本节我们从虚拟 DOM 到状态管理，通过 12 个核心模块的深度对比，彻底理清了 Vue 2 和 Vue 3 的技术脉络。掌握这些不仅能帮你应对面试，更能让你在技术选型和项目重构时做出更优决策。</p>
<p>Vue 系列暂时告一段落，下个系列我们将进入全新的【常用算法主题】，敬请期待！</p>
<p>觉得有用的话别忘了点赞收藏～ 你认为 Vue 3 最大的痛点或最香的特性是什么？欢迎在评论区留言讨论！</p>
